items.title: Credo, Marvell settle intellectual property battle over data center cable tech
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (NASDAQ:CRDO) climbed around 2% and Marvell Technology Inc (NASDAQ:MRVL) rose 0.5% in after-hours trading Tuesday after the chipmakers settled a patent dispute over high-speed data connectivity technology. The agreement clears a legal overhang in the rapidly expanding market for artificial intelligence data infrastructure, where both firms compete to supply critical hardware components.
